note:
Three further links for the newswire, found by searching the same beats as the batch 150 set — ICE protest prosecutions, protest arrests, the federal conspiracy charges — and restricted to roughly the past month. Each was fetched and returned HTTP 200 and each headline is the page's own. Two of the three carry no published date in their metadata, so the date comes from the URL path; that is recorded per item rather than left to look like a read timestamp.

As many candidates were rejected as accepted, and the rejections are listed because they say something about the feed: one was already in it, one was a fourth outlet on a story added yesterday, and two refused the fetch. A search for more turns up mostly syndication — the NPR conspiracy piece alone appears on five member-station domains — so the newswire is closer to saturated on these beats than it looks.
